```{r setup, include=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(tidyfinance)
library(scales)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggcorrplot)
```

```{r}
prices <- download_data(type = "stock_prices",
                         symbols = c("AAPL","NVDA", "JPM", "MSFT", "GOOGL", "LLY", "GOOG", "META", "ASML", "HSBC", "GS", "NESN.SW", "AMZN", "TSLA", "NEE", "CBA.AX", "WELL", "BRK-B", "NEM", "SU", "JNJ", "SIE.DE", "MU", "7203.T", "AMD", "CSCO", "ORCL", "XOM", "CAT", "ABBV"),
                         start_date = "2016-01-01",
                         end_date = "2026-04-20")
  
```

```{r}
returns <- prices %>% 
  group_by(symbol) %>% 
  arrange(date) %>% 
  mutate(dailyret = log(adjusted_close/lag(adjusted_close))) %>% 
  select(symbol, date, dailyret) %>% 
  drop_na(dailyret)

```

```{r}
returns %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = dailyret)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 100) +
  theme_minimal()
```




```{r}
assets <- returns %>% 
  group_by(symbol) %>% 
  summarize(mu = mean(dailyret),
            sd = sd(dailyret))
```

```{r}
assets %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = sd,
             y = mu,
             label = symbol)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text_repel() +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = percent) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent) +
  labs(x = "Volatility",
       y = "Expected return",
       title = "Expected returns and volatilities") +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
returns_wide <- returns %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = symbol,
              values_from = dailyret)

sigma_c <- returns_wide %>% 
  select(-date) %>% 
  cor(use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

sigma_c %>% 
ggcorrplot(
  type = "upper",
  hc.order = TRUE,
  outline.color = "white",
  colors = c("blue", "white", "red"),
  show.diag = TRUE) +
  theme(
  axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1)
)
```
